scope.en: The reaction when the first colony is founded.

texts.zh: 我们的降临对[planet.GetName]无异于一场大灾变。一股巨大的冲击波冲刷了这片没有生命的大陆，由于数百万吨的碎片被抛入大气层，[planet.GetName]的宜居性显著的下降了。我们的殖民者—被安全地包围在陨石的岩石核心—将很快从庇护处走出，并开始安装预制殖民地基础设施。
texts.en: Our arrival on [planet.GetName] is nothing short of cataclysmic. A massive shockwave scours a continent clean of life, and the habitability level of [planet.GetName] drops noticeably as megatons of debris are thrown into the atmosphere. Our colonists - encased safely within the rocky core of the meteorite - will soon emerge and begin setting up prefabricated colonial infrastructure.

texts.zh:
在[Root.GetName]的一片大陆上，我们的殖民船徐徐降落在一座巨大河口三角洲。这片气候温和的林地将会提供庇护所和唾手可得的原材料。

舰船已经被改造成了舰船改装庇护所，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
texts.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down at the mouth of a large river delta on one of the continents on [Root.GetName]. This temperate, forested area will provide shelter and easy access to raw materials.

The ship has been converted into a Reassembled Ship Shelter to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

texts.zh:

Our colony ship has found a clearing in the dense jungles of [Root.GetName] and made planetfall. Sentry drones have been deployed to guard against potential predators.

Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

texts.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down at the top of a large, flat mesa near the equator of [Root.GetName]. The rivers that flow in the canyons below provide easy access to fresh water.

The ship has been converted into a Reassembled Ship Shelter to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

texts.zh:
我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了[Root.GetName]上一片宽阔而空旷的草原，紧挨着一片巨大山脊以抵挡寒风。

texts.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the wide, empty steppe of [Root.GetName], nestled behind a large ridge, sheltering it from the cold winds.

The ship has been converted into a Reassembled Ship Shelter to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

texts.zh:
我们的殖民船徐徐降落在了[Root.GetName]上一个白雪皑皑的山谷中。周围的山脉带来了充足的保护，并且提供了可靠的水资源。

舰船已经被改造成了舰船改装庇护所，作为指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数殖民者陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
texts.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down in a snow-covered valley on [Root.GetName]. The surrounding mountain chains offer sufficient protection from the elements and provide an reliable water supply.

The ship has been converted into a Reassembled Ship Shelter to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Tents filled with construction materials, alongside prefab shelters, have sprung up around the ship's hull as colonists disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

texts.zh:
我们的殖民船缓慢的降落在覆盖着[Root.GetName]广阔的草原上。这里的大气略微干燥但同样怡人，在确定着陆点的过程中也观察到一大群温顺的食草动物。

舰船已被改造成新居住地的行政基地，它的反应堆核心正在被拆除来用作殖民地的暂时能量来源。

数百个小帐篷和简易房环绕着星舰巨大的船体，殖民者开始大片大片地登陆——在这外星世界上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]之城。
texts.en:
Our colony ship has gently touched down on the sprawling savanna that covers most of [Root.GetName]. The shimmering air is dry yet pleasant, and a large herd of docile herbivores can be seen observing from a distance as our first landing site is established.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

texts.zh:
我们的舰船想方设法，以惊人且优雅的姿态在[Root.GetName]上无数锯齿状的山峰中回旋，并成功降落在一个遮蔽山谷中的理想着陆点。

texts.en:
Our colony ship managed, with surprising grace, to maneuver between the massive peaks that are so prevalent in the jagged landscape of [Root.GetName]. It touched down in a sheltered valley that will serve as an ideal first landing site.

The ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement, and its reactor core is in the process of being removed so that it may serve as the colony's temporary power source.

Hundreds of small tents and prefab shelters have sprung up around the former starship's massive hull as colonists begin to disembark in large numbers - the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

texts.zh:
我们的殖民船成功地在[Root.GetName]进行了行星着陆。数以千计的工作单元从货仓中涌出，开始建造一座初步的部署前哨以用作殖民地扩张。地表资源矿藏的编目仍在继续，着陆点附近的侵略性野生动物已经完成了无害化处理。

资源充足后，我们现在已经准备好在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上大规模生产更多的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]单元。我们的第一个殖民地大获成功。
texts.en:
Our colony ship has successfully made planetfall on [Root.GetName]. Thousands of work units have emerged from the cargo bays to build an initial Deployment Post for settlement expansion. Efforts to catalog surface resource deposits continue, and aggressive wildlife near the landing site has been pacified.

We are now ready to mass-produce additional [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] units on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] as resources allow. Our first colony is a success.

texts.zh:
“惊奇!”[ruler.GetRegnalName]喊道。“这是个新世界，充满了新机遇！”

我们刚一把殖民船改造成大本营，第一批探险者就已经准备好面对这个星球可能给他们带来的一切挑战了。
texts.en:
"Incredible," [ruler.GetRegnalName] exclaimed. "A new world ripe with opportunity!"

As we convert our colony ship into a base camp, the first explorers are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.

texts.zh:
令人颤栗的发现！一颗遍布机遇的新星球！！

我们刚一把殖民船改造成大本营，探险节点就已经准备好面对这个星球可能给我们带来的一切挑战了。
texts.en:
A thrilling discovery! A new world ripe with opportunity!!

As we convert our colony ship into a base camp, exploratory nodes are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.

texts.zh:
我们的殖民船降落在[Root.GetName]的地表。选择的着陆场气候温和且易于获取资源矿藏。

殖民船被改造成了一座舰船改装庇护所用作指挥中心，它的反应堆心被取下来作为殖民地的临时能量来源。无数装满建材的帐篷以及简陋的棚屋如雨后春笋般出现在船体周围，无数智能人陆陆续续下船登陆，标志着[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]在外星球上第一座城市的诞生。
texts.en:
Our colony ship has touched down on the surface of [Root.GetName]. The landing site was chosen for its calm weather and accessible resource deposits.

The ship has been converted into a Reassembled Ship Shelter to serve as headquarters, and its reactor core removed to act as the colony's temporary power source. Hundreds of prefab shelters have sprung up around the ship's hull as our droids disembark, marking the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on an alien world.

殖民船被改造成了一座舰船改装庇护所用作指挥中心，我们扩散到了船体周围，用任何能找到的材料搭建起了遮蔽物。这标志着在外星球上第一个分巢的诞生。
texts.en:
Our colony ship has touched down on the surface of [Root.GetName]. The landing site was chosen for its calm weather and accessible resource deposits.

The ship has been converted into a Reassembled Ship Shelter, and around its husk, we have spread, weaving shelters from whatever materials were available. This marks the birth of a new hive on an alien world.

label.zh: 科学的进展会推动我们的殖民地更进一步。
label.en: Scientific progress will drive our colony forward.

label.zh: 我们的殖民地是崇高旨意的见证。
label.en: Our colony is a testament to our higher purpose.

label.zh: 力量和警觉才能守护我们的未来。
label.en: Strength and vigilance will secure our future.

label.zh: 我们的殖民地会在和平、和谐中繁荣昌盛。
label.en: Our colony will thrive in peace and harmony.

label.zh: 纪律与秩序将会引导我们的殖民地。
label.en: Order and hierarchy will guide our colony.

label.zh: 拥抱多样性可以让我们的殖民地更加强大。
label.en: Embracing diversity will strengthen our colony.

label.zh: 我们殖民地将拥有纯洁与安全。
label.en: Our colony will remain pure and protected.

label.zh: 如同我们的母星一般，平等将会塑造好这个殖民地。
label.en: As on our homeworld, equality will shape this colony.

label.zh: 殖民地会与蜂巢一体化发展。
label.en: The colony grows as one with the Hive.

label.zh: 殖民地将会以最高效率执行功能。
label.en: The colony will function with perfect efficiency.
